about: Every sound source used by the episode mix (sound/mix.mjs), with its licence. Add a row BEFORE a new source is used; credits.txt and credits-notes.md must agree with this file.

sources.what: Voice takes, episodes/s01e01/final/vo/*.wav (computer voices; see vo/README.md and vo/takes.json)
sources.licence: Apache License 2.0 (the model); the takes are the project's own output
sources.credit: Voices: computer-generated with Kokoro-82M by hexgrad (Apache License 2.0) - already in credits.txt

sources.what: Ambience beds sea_shore, sea_open, vista_wind_sea, grounds_wind, corridor_stone, room_sea_window, chamber_hush (sound/beds.json)
sources.origin: synthesised by sound/mix.mjs from seeded noise generators in FFmpeg (anoisesrc, aevalsrc) and filters; no recording, sample or download
sources.licence: the project's own work (no third-party material)

sources.what: Tool only (synthesis, mixing, loudness measurement, limiter, AAC encoding); nothing of FFmpeg is in the sound
sources.origin: FFmpeg (ffmpeg.org), the build the render kit already uses
sources.licence: LGPL 2.1+ / GPL 2+ (tool licence; no credit required for output)
